items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Floyd Campbell, I think, was one of the greatest blues singer I ever heard. ... INTERVIEWEE: ... And he always mentioned Floyd Campbell's singing.

ctx.x: They both knew it because I told them about it. Now in ... one night a little thing happened. Around '28 now I had my think, Stan. And, I bought my new suit on time and mother little chick with me, fine, you know. Louis Armstrong had done an afternoon in a place, in a ballroom called the Paradise.
